newsitem.title: UK: Airtours rises after glowing press report.
newsitem.headline: Airtours rises after glowing press report.

text.p: Shares in Britain's Airtours Plc rose on Monday after a report in the Observer on Sunday newspaper said the holiday company could be close to realising its dream of dominating the world's package tour industry.
Shares in the company, which reports full-year results later this week, were up 13-1/2p to 691p at 1325 GMT.
Chairman David Crossland told the Observer: "We are now the biggest air-inclusive tour operator in the world."

Airtours, which operates in Britain, Canada, Scandanavia and the United States, is forecast to deliver full-year profits on Wednesday up to 40 percent higher than last year's 59 million stg figure, analysts said.
"The shares could go up more before Wednesday," said one. "I think they will get good results."
Shares in Airtours have risen steadily since December last year when they at one stage fell as low as 307p.
